h1En: Global chip & platform leaders (mark cap order)
h1Zh: 全球芯片与平台巨头（市值口径）
editorialHtmlEn:
Ordering mirrors how NVIDIA, TSMC, Broadcom, etc. sit in public market-cap tables — not a buy list.

Unlike the portal page (mass-market web traffic), this row tracks semis and hyperscalers you see in capex / GPU supply headlines — still not investment advice; check filings and your own risk tolerance.

Last reviewed: 2026-06-18. Links favor investor-relations and official newsrooms over rumor blogs.

2026 Q2 edit: GPU supply and datacenter capex headlines still dominate my Sunday read. When a headline mentions HBM or EUV lead times, I cross-check IR pages here before writing hub copy—not YouTube “stock guru” channels.

When a GPU shortage story breaks, I open IR pages from here — not YouTube “stock guru” channels.
editorialHtmlZh:
顺序大致按公开市场上的市值梯队来排（英伟达、台积电、博通等），不是荐股清单。

与 portal 页的「大众网站流量」不同，这里偏半导体与平台型公司在算力/资本开支叙事里的位置；同样不构成投资建议，交易前请阅读各公司披露文件并自行评估风险。

最近核对：2026-06-18。链接优先投资者关系页与官方新闻稿，而非传闻聚合站。

2026 年二季度编辑注：算力与资本开支标题仍是我周日补课的主线；涉及 HBM、EUV 交期时，我会从这里进 IR 核对再改 Hub 文案，而不是点开短视频荐股号。

GPU 紧缺新闻出来时，我会从这里进 IR/新闻稿，而不是点开短视频荐股号。
rankLeadEn: Chip and platform names that usually sit near the top of public market-cap screens — order is a snapshot, not a trading signal.
rankLeadZh: 公开市值屏幕上常见靠前的芯片与平台公司；顺序为某一时间段的快照，不是交易信号。
newsLeadEn: Three IR or newsroom links per row — material news still belongs on each issuer’s own site.
newsLeadZh: 每行三条来自各公司投资者关系或新闻室的一手链接；重大信息仍以各发行人本站披露为准。
moreLeadEn: Adjacent suppliers, fabs, and software names that matter to the same capex story but rarely crack a compact top-10 row.
moreLeadZh: 与同一资本开支/算力叙事相关、但不易挤进「紧凑前十」的产业链与软件名，官方入口备查。
